# Task Tracker CLI

> A dependency-free command line to-do/task tracker written in C# (.NET 10). Add, update, delete and list tasks, mark them todo / in-progress / done. Tasks live in a tasks.json file in the current directory. MIT licensed. Installable as a .NET global tool (`task-cli`) or as a single-file binary from GitHub Releases.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, usage, JSON storage format, exit codes, architecture (SOLID, Command/Repository/Strategy patterns)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to extend commands, filters and storage

## Code map

- [src/TaskTrackerCli/Domain](src/TaskTrackerCli/Domain): TaskItem, TodoStatus, TaskFilter, exceptions
- [src/TaskTrackerCli/Application](src/TaskTrackerCli/Application): TaskService and ports (ITaskRepository, IClock)
- [src/TaskTrackerCli/Infrastructure](src/TaskTrackerCli/Infrastructure): JSON file repository
- [src/TaskTrackerCli/Cli](src/TaskTrackerCli/Cli): ICommand implementations, registry, composition root
- [tests/TaskTrackerCli.Tests](tests/TaskTrackerCli.Tests): xUnit unit and end-to-end tests

## Commands

add, update, delete, mark-in-progress, mark-done, mark-todo, list [todo|in-progress|done|not-done], help
